title: Door opening force.
officialText: The force for pushing or pulling open interior swinging egress doors, other than fire doors, shall not exceed 5-pounds (22 N). For other swinging doors, as well as sliding and folding doors, the door latch shall release when subjected to a 15-pound (67 N) force. The door shall be set in motion when subjected to a 30-pound (133 N) force. The door shall swing to a full-open position when subjected to a 15-pound (67 N) force. Forces shall be applied to the latch side of the door.
